source_quality.notes: the discount sum, the Simpson index, the air index, the vegetation index and the water index were read from the raster; the text layer drops the fraction bars

task_reconstruction: Price the environmental cost of a land use project in the short run by replacement cost and in the long run by a scored hierarchy, then compare the cost with the benefit.

section_map.summary: the two horizons and the two verdicts
the cited warning and the plan of work
the comparison matrix and the consistency test

contributions.summary: a replacement cost charged only on the pollution beyond self-purification
a long run cost widened to life quality, sustainability and the ecosystem
a comparison matrix built from counts of academic literature
a verdict shown to survive every weight on the economic cost

dependency_graph.relation: the sewage cost rejects the mill
the benefit is what the cost is compared with
the indicators are what the table ranks
the cost score accepts the stations
the weights are what the test frees

assumptions.summary: the horizon is fixed by the measurement, not by the project life
the builders ignore the environmental benefit
the evaluators weigh the environmental cost and the economic cost equally
the equal weight is a belief

data_and_preprocessing.summary: the matrix entries come from keyword counts
the paper mill numbers come from the cited industry sources
the station figures come from cited articles and the government site

verification.summary: the mill rejected by one money comparison
the stations accepted by two scores
the verdicts matched to the known outcomes

results_trace.summary: the sewage costs 11.2 million yuan against a benefit of 6 million
the adjusted cost score is 4.852 against a benefit score of 9
the cost score stays below 9 for every weight

writing_logic.summary: the requirement follows from a cited warning
the concept widens past the narrow reading
the rejection is stated and then strengthened
the remedy follows from the private motive

language_observations.summary: opens by naming the term the usual analysis leaves out
marks the omission of time as provisional
closes the case as an obligation on the officer
owns the rough matrix and the missing boundary

visualization_observations.summary: the short run cost is drawn as a tree
the short run benefit is drawn as a matching tree
the long run cost is drawn with the five indicators
the cost score is drawn against the weight before and after the adjustment

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: refusing the mill on the sewage cost alone reads as a paper that lets one comparison decide
calling the time split vague and without boundaries reads as a paper that states the limit of its own division

weaknesses.summary: the water index is called a weighted mean but divides one sum by another
the five by five matrix is given an eigenvalue of 4
the reported cost score cannot be recovered from the ranks and the weights
the matrix, the scoring, the benefit side and the time split are all owned as weak

independent_extensions.summary: price the near damage in money and the far damage by a scored hierarchy
fill a comparison matrix from the relative counts of the literature on each indicator

unresolved_questions: the water quality index divides the sum of scores by the sum of weights instead of weighting each score
the initial matrix is five by five but its eigenvalue is given as 4
the Tennessee cost score of 37/2 does not follow from the printed ranks and weights
the environmental health indicator is described but never given a formula
